title: The first close lists the report for good
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new organization that has never closed an internal or no-charge work order.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location has no accounting integration (neither QuickBooks Online nor AccountingHub).
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
  3. Click Close Work Order in the confirmation.
  4. Open Reports.
  5. Reopen work order 1 from the Finance tab.
  6. Turn the Internal Work Orders setting off.
  7. Open Reports.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The work order is Closed.

Step 4:

  • "Internal Work Orders" is listed.
  • It sits directly after Sales By Representative, in the Performance group.

Step 5:

  • Work order 1 is Complete again.

Step 6:

  • The setting is off.

Step 7:

  • "Internal Work Orders" is still listed, with the Technician Efficiency chip and the export option.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R4: “The Internal Work Orders report appears in the Reports list once the organization has closed its first internal or no-charge work order or invoiced its first work order with a no-charge line, and stays listed from then on for good, with the setting on or off and even if every closed one is later reopened, so history stays reachable (ShopView remembers that first Close or invoice for the organization; it is not derived from the closed records). Before that it is not listed, and a direct link to it shows the standard empty state. The Technician Efficiency chip (S9-R3) and the export option (S9-R6) follow the same rule (S9-N1).”
  • S9-N1: “If the organization has never closed an internal or no-charge work order nor invoiced a work order with a no-charge line, the Internal Work Orders report is not listed, the Technician Efficiency chip is not shown and the export option is not shown, whatever the setting; from that first Close or invoice on, all three show for good, with the setting on or off (S9-R4). With no row matching the filters the report shows the standard empty state.”
  • S9-E1: “A reopened internal or no-charge work order keeps its classification and leaves the Internal Work Orders report until it is closed again; it is never in the money reports. The report, the chip and the export option stay listed (S9-R4).”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026
